input: Reseed the patchy lawn before autumn sets in

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether the whole lawn needs reseeding or just specific patches changes the volume of seed, prep work, and time required dramatically.
Soil type, climate zone, and current lawn condition (compaction, thatch, weeds) directly affect which seed variety and prep method to use.
Budget determines whether to buy a basic seed mix vs. premium varieties, and whether to rent equipment like an aerator or scarifier.
Knowing if children or pets use the lawn affects which seed type is appropriate and how quickly the area needs to be back in use.
Whether the user has tools like a rake, lawn roller, or scarifier already, or needs to acquire them, shapes the immediate next steps.
Desired grass appearance (fine ornamental vs. hard-wearing utility) determines which seed blend to recommend and the maintenance level expected.
Knowing the deadline (weeks until autumn frosts) sets the urgency and determines whether there is enough germination time for the chosen method.

gold.taskTitle: Reseed patchy lawn before autumn arrives
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to repair and reseed bare or patchy areas of their lawn in time for autumn, requiring a clear plan covering preparation, materials, and execution.

questions.title: How much of the lawn is patchy — a few spots or most of it?
questions.description: Establish whether this is spot reseeding of isolated bare patches or an overseeding of the entire lawn surface, as this governs quantity of seed and effort required.

questions.title: What is your lawn's current condition and soil type?
questions.description: Understand whether the soil is compacted, sandy, clay-heavy, or thatched, and note any existing weed pressure, as this shapes ground preparation steps.

questions.title: What is your budget for this project?
questions.description: Determine how much the user is willing to spend, covering seed, any soil improvers, and potential equipment hire such as an aerator or scarifier.

questions.title: Do children or pets regularly use this lawn?
questions.description: Identify whether a hard-wearing, fast-recovery seed mix is needed, and how soon the lawn must be accessible again after reseeding.

questions.title: Which tools do you already have available at home?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a rake, lawn roller, watering equipment, or scarifier, so the plan can work with existing tools or flag what needs sourcing.

questions.title: What look do you want — lush ornamental or tough everyday grass?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user prioritises a fine, manicured finish or a resilient utility lawn, as this determines the grass seed blend to recommend.

questions.title: How many weeks do you have before your first expected autumn frost?
questions.description: Establish the hard deadline, since grass seed typically needs 6–8 weeks of mild temperatures to establish, which affects urgency and method choice.
